system.description:
The High Elven school of Myllnoris, where illusion is the purest art: creation through perception.

  • Reshapes: your Phantasm.
  • Wrought Phantasm: your Phantasm can speak in any voice you have heard and carry objects of up to 5 lb.
    • 9th level: you may keep two Phantasms; both act on your turn.
  • Art of Illusion: Advantage on Performance checks that use illusion as the medium.
